label: preparing
what: Coordinated bread supplies and hospitality for a day 1, 18:00 great-hall gathering, with its full occasion and business withheld from the mayor. Innkeeper identifies himself, builder and freight as the hospitality committee. Baker supplied bread and participated in grain/material exchanges; neighbour reports working alongside them and checking 201 loaves. Secretary knowingly arranged the precise arrival and escort, but the record does not establish that secretary, baker or neighbour knew the undisclosed purpose, nor that this was a surprise celebration or any particular secret project. Mayor was told about the meeting and eventually its bread provision, so preparation was not wholly undisclosed.
